name: relic-of-the-past
description: Relic of the Past – Electron + React + WASM
author: drizztdourden_

scripts.package: rimraf release && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --mac --linux --config electron-builder.config.js -c.directories.output=release && rimraf release/win-unpacked release/mac-arm64 release/mac release/linux-unpacked release/.icon-ico release/builder-debug.yml release/builder-effective-config.yaml
scripts.package:win: rimraf release/win && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js -c.directories.output=release/win && rimraf release/win/win-unpacked release/win/.icon-ico release/win/builder-debug.yml release/win/builder-effective-config.yaml
scripts.package:mac: rimraf release/mac && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js -c.directories.output=release/mac && rimraf release/mac/mac-arm64 release/mac/mac release/mac/.icon-ico release/mac/builder-debug.yml release/mac/builder-effective-config.yaml
scripts.package:linux: rimraf release/linux && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.js -c.directories.output=release/linux && rimraf release/linux/linux-unpacked release/linux/.icon-ico release/linux/builder-debug.yml release/linux/builder-effective-config.yaml
